decisions.reason: The trommel screen has received continued investment and renaming (BASIC to FLEX), suggesting performance meets aspirations, and organizational slack allows keeping this established product.
The flail shredder line was updated to EU Stage V in 2019, indicating ongoing commitment and likely acceptable performance relative to aspiration, so management keeps it.
The grinder line gained its own page in 2019, reflecting increased focus and no signs of shortfall, so with slack it remains in the portfolio.
The CERON pre-shredder generation is described as setting standards, signaling results above aspiration and low likelihood of problemistic search leading to drop.
